description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc class, specifically testing the support for different key systems and their versions via IPC communication. It uses Google Test framework to verify successful and failure scenarios, including channel disconnections and reconnections.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcKeySystemsTest
